findings.title: Restart lacks blank-model spawn test
findings.problem: The 17408 spec requires tests that proxy start and proxy restart spawn with the profile's model and pass none for a config without a model or with a blank one. proxy start covers none/blank/set (it.each at line 690), but the proxy restart describe (line 2802) only covers a set model and a missing one; no restart case passes a blank ('  ') model.
findings.impact: A required spec test criterion is only partially met; a regression in restart's blank-model handling (e.g. a blank override winning over normalization) would ship undetected.
findings.recommendation: In the `proxy restart` describe (line 2802), add a case where the loaded profile's model is blank ('  ') — for a stopped daemon and/or with --profile — and assert `spawnDaemon` is called with `model` undefined, mirroring the `proxy start` it.each at line 690.
findings.check_notes: index.test.ts:3180 stopped-daemon blank model asserts no model property; :3192 --profile blank model asserts model undefined; both in proxy restart describe

decision.outcome: fixed in code (commit 27b2503c, test(proxy): cover a blank profile model on proxy restart; document isSymbolicLink)
decision.rationale: src/cli/commands/proxy/__tests__/index.test.ts, describe 'proxy restart', has two new cases: 'starts a stopped daemon without a model when the profile's model is blank' (the loaded config's model is two spaces, the spawn options have no model property) and 'starts without a model when --profile names a profile whose model is blank' (a running daemon whose state holds a model, --profile other with a blank model, the spawn's model is undefined, so neither the blank value nor the old state's model is passed). With normalizeDaemonModel(config.model) replaced by config.model in launch-daemon.ts both cases fail.

findings.title: Exported isSymbolicLink missing JSDoc
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Comments & Documentation) requires JSDoc on all public APIs; isSymbolicLink() is newly exported by this change and imported by desktop.ts and claude-code-otlp.ts, but has no JSDoc block.
findings.impact: A documented project code-quality rule is unmet for an exported API introduced by this change, which the standards audit treats as blocking.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-line JSDoc above `isSymbolicLink` stating it returns true only for a symbolic link and false when the path is missing or unreadable.
findings.check_notes: vscode.ts:324 JSDoc line above exported isSymbolicLink

decision.outcome: fixed in code (commit 27b2503c, test(proxy): cover a blank profile model on proxy restart; document isSymbolicLink)
decision.rationale: src/cli/commands/proxy/connectors/vscode.ts: the exported isSymbolicLink has a JSDoc line saying it is true only for a symbolic link and false for any other path and when the path is missing or cannot be read.
